requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver reads the IWDG_SR.EWIF field, the IWDG LL driver shall return 1U if the EWIF bit is set in IWDG_SR register, else 0U.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the IWDG_SR.EWIF bit is set and the function returns 1U, or when the IWDG_SR.EWIF bit is clear and the function returns 0U.
